title: spathelia excelsa
intro: Spathelia excelsa, commonly known as the wild jasmine, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of the Americas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Spathelia excelsa include its ability to act as a sedative and anxiolytic, making it a potential treatment for insomnia and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Spathelia excelsa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide relief from various health conditions.
